entities.name: Brenalt
entities.description: A general on Shandalar who made an Angelic Accord.

entities.name: Angel
entities.description: The unnamed angel who answers Brenalt's prayer.

entities.name: Mattias
entities.description: Soldier who bled out beside Brenalt.

entities.name: River's Glen
entities.description: Brenalt's home, lost to the undead.

entities.name: Xathrid necromancer
entities.description: Necromancer leading the horde of the dead.

events.summary: Brenalt's company is overwhelmed by undead; his friends die.
events.quote: One by one, his friends fell before the onslaught.

events.summary: In a ruined shrine, Brenalt prays and an angel appears, sealing the Angelic Accord.
events.quote: He felt the Angelic Accord seal within him.

events.summary: A Banisher Priest accuses Brenalt of a dark deal; Brenalt says it was with an angel.
events.quote: Brenalt admitted he had made a deal but with an angel

events.summary: Brenalt rises to Captain, then General after improbable victories.
A scout reports the loss of the Fourth Legion, Greenfield and River's Glen.
events.quote: Brenalt could only mourn the loss of his home.

events.summary: Brenalt spots the Xathrid necromancer and makes a last stand, and the angel returns to save them.
events.quote: The angel had returned to save them all in their darkest hour

relations.quote: Brenalt is a general on Shandalar who made an Angelic Accord.
He had been at war with the undead for eight years
